reported.title: No 38 °C release threshold; fan drops out as soon as temp falls below 42 °C
reported.description: The control logic at lines 66-73 uses a single trip point: it calls applyFan(false) whenever lastTempC < FAN_ON_C (42.0), so the fan turns OFF the moment temperature dips below 42 °C instead of holding ON until 38 °C. In the rapid-override scenario the measured evidence shows D8 was in the wrong state for 599 ms across 3 intervals (e.g. 1000.633-1200.314 s, 'D8 was not LOW for 200 ms while required'), because the override release path at line 72 immediately forces the fan OFF at 25 °C rather than latching. D8 was in the wrong state for 599 ms across 3 interval(s), first at 1.00 s: D8 was not LOW for 200 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: No hysteresis or input filtering causes relay chatter
reported.description: The comparison at line 66 is a bare single-threshold test on an unfiltered 50 ms sample (lines 53-56), so any noise or oscillation around 42 °C toggles the relay on every sample. Measured evidence: 57 toggles in a 5000 ms window during threshold hover, 34 toggles during rapid oscillation, and 8 toggles from a brief glitch spike, all far above the limit of 2. D8 toggled 57 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms (limit 2), and 77 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 temperature probe on A0 scaled at 10 mV/°C; ridge-vent relay on D8; override pushbutton on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the vent fan ON when attic temperature reaches 42.0 °C or above, and turn it OFF when temperature falls to 38.0 °C or below.
- While D3 is held LOW, force the fan ON regardless of temperature.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print one status line every 1000 ms in the form `attic: <temp> C fan=ON` or `attic: <temp> C fan=OFF` with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
